correctness.rationale: For each k, the future increment S_n-S_k is independent of S_k and centered, so its contribution against the event S_k>0 vanishes. Symmetry gives E[S_k 1{S_k>0}]=E|S_k|/2. Summation proves the exact covariance. The classical Sparre-Andersen discrete arcsine law yields Var(A_n)=n(n+1)/8. Finite variance gives uniform integrability of S_k/(sigma sqrt(k)), so the central limit theorem transfers to first absolute moments and yields the stated universal correlation limit.

value.rationale: The positive-sojourn count is the canonical arcsine statistic and terminal displacement is the canonical endpoint statistic of a one-dimensional random walk. The theorem gives an exact finite local-to-global covariance and, after combining with Sparre-Andersen universality, a nonzero distribution-free limiting correlation. The exact Brownian match shows the constant is a stable discrete-to-continuum dependence feature rather than a small finite-size artifact.
